summary: Bugsink is a self-hosted ticketing and error-tracking tool designed to aggregate application exceptions in real time. It centralises debugging logs and diagnostic details to help developers monitor software failures from a single interface.
goodFor: Teams looking for an alternative to managed SaaS error tracking who want to keep their application logs on their own infrastructure.
watchOut: It uses a proprietary licence, meaning you cannot freely modify or redistribute the source code despite being able to self-host it.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application written in Python, you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
